note: Prefix of the model slug Cursor reports, mapped to the model family disensor declares. Cursor does not publish stable slugs: its models page lists display names, so this table is maintained by hand and is deliberately incomplete. Vendors known to be none of the five named families map to 'other', which can only understate independence. A slug whose vendor is not known, because Cursor picks the model or serves its own, stays UNMAPPED, and unmapped means nothing is prefilled: calling it 'other' would let R4 certify a decorrelation that may not exist.

deliberately_unmapped.auto: Cursor picks the model. The slug does not say which one ran, so the generator cannot be declared.
deliberately_unmapped.composer: Cursor's own models. What they are built on is not published: if it were one of the five named families, 'other' would overstate independence.
